file. Is that on purpose

This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

The byte order mark is included deliberately to help spreadsheet software like Microsoft Excel recognize the file as UTF-8. Because this is intentional and expected behaviour, no code changes are required, and users encountering this in scripts can handle it via encodings like utf-8-sig as noted.
